397565.title: Yoon Jun-ho: Breath, Leaking Light
397565.overview: A solo exhibition by Yoon Jun-ho at a small gallery on the slope below Namsan in Itaewon. Free, and close enough to Namsan Park and the Itaewon restaurant streets to fold into an afternoon there.

394455.title: Ilmu: Gestures of the Eight Winds — Eleventh in the Series
394455.overview: Ilmu is the line dance performed at the Jongmyo Jerye, the royal ancestral rite of the Joseon court — dancers in ranked rows moving in unison, holding a flute and a pheasant-feather wand. Both the rite and its music are on UNESCO's list of Intangible Cultural Heritage. This is the eleventh instalment of the National Gugak Center's series reconstructing the full ilmu repertoire, staged in its main concert hall rather than at the shrine.

394411.title: Jeongeum: Retirement Concert for Lee Jong-gil
394411.overview: A retirement concert for the gayageum player Lee Jong-gil, performed with the Chunho Gayageum Ensemble. Free admission, in the National Gugak Center's mid-size hall — a rare chance to hear a full gayageum ensemble at no cost.
